title: ChatVisibilitySessionContext
description: Active visibility workbench session context captured by the UI when contextual page chat is submitted.

workspaceFamily.description: Type of workbench session attached to this chat turn.

bindingHash.description: Opaque server-issued hash for the topology binding currently attached to the session.

pendingProposalId.description: Pending proposal previewed in the UI, when present.

selectedElements.description: Current selected elements on the workbench surface.

selectedLayerIds.description: Workbench layer ids currently selected or focused in the UI.
